title: iLogic Formatter settings
description: Formatting and hint settings for the iLogic rules in this folder and the folders below it. Read by the iLogic Formatter extension and by ilogic-format.

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines.

blankLineAfterBlock.description: Insert a blank line after End Sub / End Function / End Property.

normalizeComments.description: Ensure a space after the comment apostrophe.

normalizeUnicode.description: Replace lookalike Unicode characters in code with their ASCII equivalents.

allowCommentedCatch.description: Do not report an empty Catch that holds a comment.

vbFilesAreILogic.description: Treat .vb files as iLogic rules (the default). Set to false for folders with regular VB.NET code: the editor leaves those files as Visual Basic, and ilogic-format skips them in folders and gives them no convention hints.
